# Purpose
This generated header defines the metric metadata for the `snapct` area of the codebase. It maps each metric to a fixed offset, a metric name, a metric type, a short description, and a converter setting, so other parts of the program can register and read these values in a consistent way. The file covers snapshot loading state, byte counts for full and incremental snapshot transfer, retry counts, predicted replay slot, and gossip peer counts. The `FD_METRICS_SNAPCT` array declaration provides the complete metric set for this group, while the include guard and generated-file notice control how the header is used in the build.
